auditScope: 37 location errors from initial 100-offer holdout benchmark

discrepancyClarification.reportedDiscrepancy: Previous report claimed 22 label defects in headline, but narrative breakdown in geo-generalization-report.md totaled 23 (14+6+2+1).
discrepancyClarification.rootCauseOfDiscrepancy: Typographical count error in narrative markdown text: FALLBACK_ADDRESS_POLLUTION was written as "14 cases" in prose, whereas gold-label-corrections.json contains exactly 13 cases (13 + 6 + 2 + 1 = 22).

caseLevelAudit.merchant: Enjoy a 20% off at Kelly Felder with your NSB Mastercard Debit Card
caseLevelAudit.sourceEvidenceCitation: location: "both Debit and Credit Cards" | addresses: ["both Debit and Credit Cards, Sri Lanka"] | rawSnippet: "Enjoy a 20% off at Kelly Felder with your NSB Mastercard Debit Card! Discount : 20% Off (both Debit and Credit"
caseLevelAudit.dispositionRationale: NSB scraper extracted card eligibility text ("both Debit and Credit Cards") into location field. However, description body contained "Location details : Colombo 03 | Nugegoda | Colombo City Centre, Level 02 | Wattala". Resolved: card text stripped from location, and multi-branch text parser successfully extracts all participating branches.

caseLevelAudit.merchant: Enjoy upto 30% off at Hayleys hotels with your NSB Mastercard Debit Card
caseLevelAudit.sourceEvidenceCitation: location: "Enjoy upto 30% off at Hayleys hotels with your NSB Mastercard Debit Card" | addresses: ["Enjoy upto 30% off at Hayleys hotels with your NSB Mastercard Debit Card, Sri Lanka"] | rawSnippet: "Enjoy upto 30% off at Hayleys hotels with your NSB Mastercard Debit Card! Amaya Resorts and Spas (up-to 30%) A"
caseLevelAudit.dispositionRationale: Raw source text lists multiple participating properties: Amaya Hills – Kandy, Amaya Lake – Dambulla, Amaya Beach – Pasikudah, The Villas Wadduwa, Langdale Nuwara Eliya. Previously missed because regex only checked Jetwing. Resolved by multi-property chain matcher extracting 3+ distinct properties.

caseLevelAudit.sourceEvidenceCitation: location: "." | rawSnippet: "Gourmet Bakery Discount 10% off on cakes and breads ."
caseLevelAudit.dispositionRationale: NDB bank scraper passed punctuation "." as location string, which tricked address normalizer into creating a physical location. Resolved: punctuation and whitespace noise strings are stripped to empty, preventing false venue detection.

caseLevelAudit.sourceEvidenceCitation: location: "Batticaloa" | addresses: ["Batticaloa, Sri Lanka"] | rawSnippet: "Lanka Hospitals Diagnostics 15% discount on diagnostics at Lanka Hospitals in Batticaloa Batticaloa"
caseLevelAudit.dispositionRationale: Source names a single city without street address (e.g. "Batticaloa"). Scope classifier previously over-indexed on district list and assigned DISTRICT_REGION (norm: MULTI_BRANCH). Resolved: single city without district keyword classifies as EXPLICIT_BRANCH with addressPrecision: CITY_OR_DISTRICT_ONLY and exactPinEligibility: false.

caseLevelAudit.sourceEvidenceCitation: location: "Selected SPAR Supermarkets" | rawSnippet: "SPAR Supermarket Promotion Available only at selected SPAR supermarkets in the Western province Selected SPAR "
caseLevelAudit.dispositionRationale: Raw source states location: "Selected SPAR Supermarkets" and description: "Available only at selected SPAR supermarkets in the Western province". Parser correctly assigned SELECTED_OUTLETS (norm: MULTI_BRANCH). Benchmark reference label erroneously expected UNRESOLVED.

caseLevelAudit.merchant: Galle Face Hotel exclusively for DFCC World Mastercard cardholders
caseLevelAudit.sourceEvidenceCitation: rawSnippet: "{"cardType":"Credit Card","offerText":"25% off dining at Galle Face Hotel exclusively for DFCC World Mastercar"
caseLevelAudit.dispositionRationale: Offer is for "Galle Face Hotel", a single historic luxury heritage hotel venue in Colombo. The original benchmark label incorrectly defaulted to UNRESOLVED because addresses array was empty. The venue is an unambiguous single physical establishment (SINGLE_CONCRETE_VENUE) without a street address (addressPrecision: VENUE_NAME_ONLY), correctly resulting in isGeocodableToCoordinates = false.

caseLevelAudit.dispositionRationale: Bank scraper output explicitly contains location: "Islandwide" for Arpico Supercentre. The benchmark reference label omitted this bank metadata and defaulted to UNRESOLVED. Grounded in source evidence, the correct scope is NATIONWIDE (all islandwide outlets).
